scope: Controlled grammatical intervention and genuinely fresh relational holdout; fixed clause delimiter, closed training vocabulary, no inferred labels supplied to the decoder
targeted_training_templates: The receiving party is {recipient} while the supplier is {actor}; the asset to be delivered is the {asset}; upon {condition}, {duty}, and the consequence recorded is {consequence}
Transfer of the {asset} to {recipient} from {actor} is specified after {condition}; the obligation language {duty}, and the result designated is {consequence}
For {asset} delivery, the beneficiary is {recipient} and {actor} is named as supplier; once {condition}, the clause {modal} act, with {consequence} stated as the outcome
new_holdout_templates: The actor is {actor} and the recipient is {recipient}; the item of transfer is {asset}; once {condition}, {duty}, with {consequence} stipulated as outcome
For {recipient}, delivery from {actor} of {asset} is contemplated upon {condition}; the supplier {modal} complete the delivery, and the resulting consequence is {consequence}
If {condition}, {recipient} is identified as beneficiary of {asset} supplied by {actor}; {duty} for that delivery, and the named outcome is {consequence}
Outcome {consequence} governs the proposed {asset} handover from {actor} to {recipient} after {condition}; the agreement says {duty} for that handover
